component.name: Dmn Bluetooth (COSMIC)
component.summary: Monitor iPhone notifications over Bluetooth ANCS

description.p: Native COSMIC frontend for Dmn's BlueZ and Apple Notification Center Service monitoring.

screenshot.caption: Monitor Bluetooth devices and review incoming notifications.
View application information and recent monitoring activity.

description.p: Introducing Dmn Bluetooth, a native COSMIC desktop app for discovering and monitoring Bluetooth devices that expose Apple Notification Center Service (ANCS).

ul.li: Browse BlueZ-known and nearby Bluetooth devices, save device selections, and explicitly connect or disconnect.
Start and stop ANCS monitoring for eligible devices; saved selections and monitoring choices are restored when the app restarts.
Search and sort devices, and review a searchable notification-event feed with device and event filters.
Optionally show generic desktop alerts for new notifications. Alerts are enabled by default and do not include device names or notification text.

description.p: Requirements and limitations: Linux with BlueZ and a COSMIC desktop session; monitoring requires a paired, connected ANCS-capable device. The feed is kept in memory for the current session and shows events received while monitoring; it does not retrieve complete notification history. Bluetooth adapter behavior and simultaneous monitoring of multiple devices depend on the supported system and devices.
